*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#24324a;background:#f4f6fa}header{height:64px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e6eaf0;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 28px;gap:12px}header strong{font-size:22px;color:#1684df}header small{margin-left:auto;color:#8995a6}.layout{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - 64px)}aside{width:216px;background:#fff;padding:28px 20px;color:#66748b}aside div{padding:13px;margin-bottom:8px;border-radius:6px}.selected{background:#eaf4ff;color:#1478ce}main{flex:1;padding:30px;min-width:0}h1{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:#7e8ba0}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4eaf1;border-radius:8px;padding:24px;margin-top:24px}.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:24px}input{border:1px solid #dce3ec;border-radius:5px;padding:10px 12px;min-width:230px}button{border:0;border-radius:5px;background:#1684df;color:white;padding:10px 18px;cursor:pointer}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;text-align:left}th{font-weight:500;color:#8390a4;background:#f8faff}td,th{padding:16px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f4}td button{background:none;color:#1684df;padding:0}.pill{background:#e8f7ef;color:#219267;font-size:12px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px}pre{background:#f5f8fc;padding:20px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-height:90px;color:#41516a}.muted{font-size:12px;color:#9ba7b7}@media(max-width:700px){aside{display:none}main{padding:16px}.card{padding:14px}input{min-width:0;width:100%}.toolbar{flex-wrap:wrap}table{font-size:12px}td,th{padding:12px 5px}}
aside a{display:block;padding:13px;margin-bottom:8px;border-radius:6px;color:#66748b;text-decoration:none}aside a:hover{background:#f3f7fb}.summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:24px}.summary-grid section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4eaf1;border-radius:8px;padding:20px}.summary-grid span{display:block;color:#7e8ba0;font-size:12px}.summary-grid strong{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:22px;font-weight:600}td:first-child{overflow-wrap:anywhere}main>p a{color:#1478ce}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #126fcc;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:700px){header{padding:0 16px}header strong{font-size:19px}header span{font-size:12px}header small{display:none}.summary-grid{gap:8px}.summary-grid section{padding:12px}.summary-grid strong{font-size:17px}}

const output=document.getElementById('output');async function load(file){output.textContent='正在打开文件…';try{const r=await fetch('/api/download?file='+encodeURIComponent(file));output.textContent=await r.text()}catch(e){output.textContent='文件服务暂不可用'}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-file]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>load(b.dataset.file)));document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('click',()=>load(document.getElementById('query').value||'README.md'));
